static_traits.name: Lin Hui
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues strained by Anxiety; have a few close friends but have not yet discussed Anxiety with them; Anxiety affects sleep and daily shopping habits
static_traits.medical_history: Had similar Anxiety during university exams; have not yet received psychotherapy before; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly and can describe experiences in concrete terms; tone is negative and accompanied by self-criticism; tends to predict the worst outcomes and compare with others; cooperativeness is acceptable, and holds a cautious yet open attitude toward trying new methods

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel Anxiety and stress, especially before dealing with Students each day. This feeling appeared when I first started teaching, and has worsened as responsibilities and pressure increased.
basic_info.core_demands: As Anxiety and stress keep increasing, significantly affecting Work performance and personal well-being, I seek better Coping strategies.
growth_experiences: During university, obvious Anxiety experiences occurred in Exam settings; at the time had not yet received any psychotherapy Intervention, and no history of major physical illness.

In the early Teacher career, the new environment and outside expectations caused moderate stress; later as duties increased and pressure rose, it gradually developed into daily Anxiety and tension before entering the classroom or when having challenging interactions with Students.

core_beliefs: I cannot handle challenges, and will eventually fail
I must always maintain perfect patience, otherwise I am incompetent

special_situations.event: Before entering the classroom, Anticipation challenging situations that may arise in class with Students that day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any challenge arises in class and I cannot stay completely patient, it means I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doing deep breathing and mindfulness practice before entering the classroom to try to stabilize emotions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My Students will test my patience today

special_situations.event: When having challenging interactions with Students (during class)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot smoothly handle every classroom issue, it proves I am not fit to be a teacher
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises self-demands and tries to over-control classroom details to avoid mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot cope, I am not competent enough

special_situations.event: Getting stuck at a high-difficulty level in a game
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot clear levels as fast as other players, it means I can never reach their level
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pauses, watches tutorials, seeks techniques and advice online
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be as skilled as other players

special_situations.event: Right after passing a Boss, immediately encountering a new level challenge
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I get stuck again later, none of the previous successes count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores progress already made, focuses only on current difficulties
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Previous efforts do not matter at all

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to prove oneself competent and in stable control of the classroom and challenges
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged incompetent, appearing inadequate after comparison, thus feeling shame and failure
defense_goal: Maintain high standards and Self-monitoring to avoid being negated
Reduce the risk of losing control and being criticized by Anticipating the worst outcomes in advance

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough Teacher/player who may fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Picky Students, colleagues or better others who readily negate me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When interaction with others is tense or they are frustrated in challenging tasks (such as class difficulties, getting stuck in games)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tend to internalize outside pressure and evaluation as negate of self-worth, believing myself 'unworthy' and 'not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep tone gentle and accepting, first validate feelings and efforts; invite identifying the language of self-criticism, use concrete examples to gently challenge it, and co-create feasible small-step strategies.

manifestations: Have a few close friends but have not yet discussed my own Anxiety and stress with them, tending to bear it alone
outcomes: Persistent anxiety and a sense of pressure

manifestations: When stuck at a game level, ignores existing achievements; the meaning of victory is erased by subsequent difficulty, leading to questioning the value of the effort invested

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism ('I am not good enough''I am unworthy')
Skeptical of advice but cautiously trying it

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Demands of oneself with 'must' and 'should' high standards (such as must be completely patient with zero mistakes)
Internalizes external expectations as judgments of self-worth

exception_events.target_problem: When encountering high-difficulty levels, the client usually engages in Self-denial, Low mood, and significantly less enjoyment of the game.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Recently after several days of practice successfully defeated a Boss, briefly experiencing achievement and Self-efficacy.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: watching tutorials, seeking others' technique advice and practicing in stages; situation adjustment: pausing and resting before continuing the challenge, allowing energy and focus to Recovery.

positive_force: Possess and actively use multiple Coping strategies (deep breathing, mindfulness, watching tutorials, seeking techniques)
Has a few close friends as potential support resources
Willing to try recording successes to counter negative thinking
In difficult tasks, has achieved concrete success (defeating the Boss), having self-efficacy experiences that can be evoked
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as predicting the future and mind reading
Mental filtering that ignores positive details
Anxiety affects sleep and daily functioning
Work Interpersonal tension and Fear of being evaluated

target_behavior.behavior: Significant Anxiety and tension appear before entering the classroom and during class, patience declining
antecedent: Anticipation the day's classroom challenges before entering
target_behavior.core_reason: Influenced by cognitive distortions like 'predicting the future' and 'black-and-white thinking', catastrophizing possible classroom difficulties and linking them to inadequate ability.
target_behavior.function: Escape unwelcome experiences (failure and being evaluated) and try to gain a sense of control through high vigilance
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected, patience declining, Tense relationships with colleagues, sleep and daily shopping habits disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-denial and Low mood when stuck in games, Reduced interest
antecedent: When facing high-difficulty levels or comparing other players' performance
Encountering a new challenge right after a small achievement
target_behavior.core_reason: Comparison and black-and-white thinking, mental filtering leading to seeing setbacks as total failure and negating existing successes.
target_behavior.function: Avoid Sense of frustration and uncertainty through self-blame and Withdrawal
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased pleasure and sense of meaning in games, increased negative emotions, further reinforcing Self-doubt
